messages:
claire: Heads-up from today's hardening pass on staging base-image: a few issues for coord — world-writable /tmp dir, openssl package behind, and several tags missing cosign signatures.

nate: missing signatures will stop our deploy gate. Do we know if cosign errored or signing step skipped?

claire: bake logs show cosign failing with KMS permission denied. Looks like an RBAC restriction removed kms.sign for the CI principal.

yvonne: which role change? @kevin?

kevin: yeah, I narrowed the builder role last sprint to remove broad Sign rights. I didn't realize the bake used that service account. I can add a narrowly scoped kms.cryptoSign binding for the cosign key scoped to ci-builder@redwood-prod.

nate: good. Please include an expiry tag and a short justification in the PR. Also add a fail-fast verify in the bake job so unsigned images fail the pipeline.

claire: suggested verify snippet to add to bake job:

```
if ! cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-key ${IMAGE_URI}; then
  echo "PROVENANCE FAIL: unsigned image"; exit 1
fi
```

kevin: will do. I'll open the RBAC PR and include rollback steps (how to remove the binding via gcloud).

yvonne: audit asked for image pull events in the timeline; currently we only capture kubelet start/stop. We should enable containerd event forwarding in staging with a narrow pull/create filter so the shipper isn't overwhelmed.

nate: sample staging config to test:

```
containerd:
  enabled: true
  events: ["pull","create"]
filters:
  - event: pull
    fields: [image,registry,digest,node]
output:
  url: https://audit-shipper.internal/ingest
```

claire: migration for existing unsigned images: rebuild + repush preferred to preserve provenance. We'll schedule a rebuild window and canary.

kevin: PR link coming. I'll tag @claire and @yvonne for approval and add an expiry of 7 days. Also documenting rollback runbook: remove binding, quarantine tags via registry API, revert bake change.

audit-bot: scan results: staging/base-image:4287654321 failed CIS checks (5) and provenance checks (2). https://ci.internal/scans/4287654321

yvonne: thanks. Claire, can you own the rebuild runway? propose Sun 03:00-05:00 PT for canary.

claire: I can. I'll coordinate and post results. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
